GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Pushed fwd & raced 3rd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Raced keenly & held ground midrace until pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & faded in last 100m. # On-pace/faded.

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to Turn then Hooked Out to 8.5 Lengths 3 Wide , hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in Straight # back/ran on ok

Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & held ground in last 150m. # Good for easier

Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Settled Worse than midfield rails 5 Lengths 600m, came off fence soon after Straightening Up but in traffic, Made Good Ground last 200m and was not far off placing # Even Effort
Jumped Ok drove through to lead half clear, held together turn, joint lead Straightening Up , same 200m, took over approaching 100m, drew half clear 50m, got tired late, did enough # led/fell in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 50m shifted out abruptly under pressure before being corrected. The Veterinary Officer reported that the mare sustained superficial abrasions to the near hind fetlock.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing less than a length, held together much same to turn 2 Lengths rail, steered Four Wide Straightening Up and lost a little ground in straight. (Tongue Control Bit OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie AGAIN) [Stewards: Inclined to hang throughout. Post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery.] # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to hang out throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare revealed it to have a slow recovery.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 300m & weakened in straight. # On-pace/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated his mount led the event and travelled comfortably in the early and middle stages. Rdr stated that when asked to sprint on straightening his mounts effort was short lived and it commenced to weaken approaching the 200m. Tnr advised that he had experimented with tongue control gear for todays event which appears to have been unsuccessful. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat 2 Lengths off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, battled on well # even effort
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a neck, railed to Lead mid-race, led rail by a head turning, Headed 250m and Lost Ground from there # weak once headed
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn and kept battling in Straight # battled on ok
